claims.statement: For any v in {0, 1}^n, ||v||_p^p = wt(v) for all p >= 1; l1 and l2 minimizations coincide identically over F2, refuting purported norm separation claims.

claims.name: Continuous-to-Discrete Transfer Bound under Open-System Dynamics
claims.statement: In the declared analytical open-system Lindblad envelope model with quasiparticle poisoning gamma_qp > 0, the upper-bound trade-off envelope on the trace-norm transfer defect Delta_transfer has a strictly positive minimum Delta_min > 0; Lean 4 transfer_defect_lower_bound_pos verifies the integer arithmetic positivity (Nat.mul_pos) of the declared rate-duration product rather than an unconditional physical trace-distance lower bound.

claims.name: Non-Markovian Memory-Kernel Transfer Bounds
claims.statement: Structured bosonic bath spectra J(omega) = 2*pi*alpha * omega_c^(1-s) * omega^s * exp(-omega/omega_c) alter the Pareto scaling exponent beta = 2 / (p + 2) for the minimum transfer defect Delta_min, with sub-Ohmic noise (s < 1) accelerating dephasing and sub-gap cutoffs (omega_c < Delta) exponentially suppressing bulk leakage while maintaining Delta_min > 0 for any alpha > 0.

claims.name: Multi-Terminal Cross-Junction Transfer Bounds under Potential Disorder
claims.statement: In multi-terminal nanowire cross-junctions (M >= 4), M(M-1)/2 >= 6 inter-arm cross-talk channels and electrostatic potential disorder sigma_V monotonically degrade the effective topological gap Delta_eff(sigma_V), elevating the Pareto transfer defect infimum Delta_min^(M) > 0 for all sigma_V < sigma_crit.
